label: D1 after a rare a2->S1 transition (early/mid episode)
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires at D1 (92% of activation mass; never at GO) of the trial after the agent chose a2 and got a rare transition to S1. On D1 steps whose previous trial is in the window, every activation has prev_action==2, and nearly all are rare ones (adding prev_common==0 raises precision from 0.16 to 0.59 without losing recall). Prior reward does not matter much. It also turns off late in the episode (no activity after trial ~80, peak at trials 20-40); adding ep_trial<70 raises dev precision to 0.83 (dev F1 0.58, mass recall 0.72). Recall is low for two reasons: (1) D1 steps at the window start (rel -3), where the previous trial is not in the window, hold about 15% of the mass and are probably the same condition but cannot be checked (including them gives mass recall 0.87); (2) weak D2 activations when S2 is reached (in_state==S2, mostly a2-common), which hold about 8% of the mass. Never fires at GO, after an a1 choice, or at D2 in S1. Uses only observed variables.
